Tiṇṇaṉ.gloss: The hunter later called Kaṇṇappar in Sēkkiḻār's Tamil Śaiva saint-life.

Kaṇṇappar.gloss: The hunter Tiṇṇaṉ, named Kaṇṇappar when Śiva stops him from offering his second eye.

Kāḷatti.gloss: The hill shrine of Śiva in Kaṇṇappar's Tamil Śaiva saint-life; associated with present-day Śrīkālahasti.

Dakṣa.gloss: Satī's father, who excludes Śiva from his sacrifice in the Śiva Purāṇa.

Satī.gloss: Daughter of Dakṣa and consort of Śiva in the Śiva Purāṇa.

Vīrabhadra.gloss: Fierce leader brought forth by Śiva after Satī's death in the Śiva Purāṇa.

Dadhīci.gloss: Sage who objects to Śiva's exclusion from Dakṣa's sacrifice and leaves the gathering.

Rohiṇī.gloss: The Moon's companion on the journey to Dakṣa's sacrifice in this Śiva Purāṇa telling.

Vijayā.gloss: Satī's friend who asks where the Moon and Rohiṇī are going.
